method: Mapped every DELIVERY-produced typed fault/rejection named by the first vertical slice into D9's closed public code vocabulary while drafting the contract-to-module map.

findings.evidence: delivery.v2 rustSemanticSubstrate.providerProtocol.frameIntegrity emitted PROVIDER.PROTOCOL_FAULT, while D9's closed vocabulary and provider-protocol map permit only PROVIDER.PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.
findings.impact: An implementer must either violate D9's closed vocabulary or silently invent a normalization rule.
findings.requiredChange: Use the D9 canonical error code and mechanically cross-check DELIVERY against the live D9 map.

findings.evidence: DELIVERY requires excluded forms to return FEATURE.REQUIRES_CAPABILITY_RUNTIME, but D9 has no such public errorCode or rejectionCause and declares its vocabulary closed.
findings.impact: The first admission path for an intentionally excluded feature has no deterministic host-termination derivation.
findings.requiredChange: Bind FEATURE.REQUIRES_CAPABILITY_RUNTIME as typed domain detail and map it to D9 extension-admission-rejected / EXTENSION.ADMISSION_REJECTED, or explicitly evolve D9.
